page_title: CAG 1-0 JUV | Cagliari v Juventus 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes it short.
90+3' The ball possession at the moment is 22:78.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonathan David.
87' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
84' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Elia Caprile has no trouble gathering it.
84' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!
81' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' Luciano Spalletti has decided to substitute Andrea Cambiaso and he is replaced by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
80' Substitution. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Weston McKennie walks off.
79' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile makes a comfortable save.
76' The resulting corner, taken by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), comes to nothing.
72' Juventus take a short corner kick.
72' There's an opportunity for Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
71' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
70' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
66' Substitution. Manuel Locatelli walks off the pitch and Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
66' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Lois Openda (Juventus) replaces Fabio Miretti.

65' 1 - 0 It's the free kick. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) gets on the end of a cross from Gianluca Gaetano and shows great technique to fire the ball into the back of the net. His effort from the edge of the box flies into the bottom right corner and changes the score to 1:0.
64' Substitution. Sebastiano Esposito is replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).

64' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Elia Caprile, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
62' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

60' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
57' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
57' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) launches a cross from the corner, but Elia Caprile is alert to thwart the effort.
57' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Elia Caprile has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
54' The referee signals a substitution. Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Semih Kilicsoy.
51' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Jonathan David (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
50' The resulting corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

49' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mattia Perin with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a short corner kick.
46' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
45+1' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A raking crossfield pass from Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
43' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
41' The foul by Marco Palestra (Cagliari) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Juventus win a free kick.
39' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
38' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' The Cagliari players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' Wow, what an escape. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
33' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
31' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) for a tough tackle.
28' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mattia Perin comes off the line to clear the ball away.
27' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) trips an opposition player and Davide Massa signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.

25' This was a piece of cake for Elia Caprile. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
24' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
21' Jonathan David (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
19' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
17' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Juventus as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
16' There's a break in play and referee Davide Massa must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Juventus using VAR. This could be interesting!
15' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty for Juventus!

13' Weston McKennie (Juventus) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
11' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' A clumsy foul by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) and Davide Massa blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
5' The game is interrupted as Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is flagged offside.
2' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
2' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Davide Massa.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
